live_cross_service_proof.description: Real Python uvicorn service (port 8100) and real Node backend (port 3099, tsx watch) run as separate live processes, backend pointed at the live Python service via DEVICE_AI_SERVICE_URL. No mocks on either side of the P6.5 proxy boundary.

happy_path.backend_proxy: GET http://127.0.0.1:3099/api/v1/system/blockchain/health -> status=disabled, fabricEnabled=false (correctly transformed to camelCase)

degradation_path.action: Python process killed mid-session; backend NOT restarted
degradation_path.result: GET http://127.0.0.1:3099/api/v1/system/blockchain/health -> status=proxy_unreachable, message='Could not reach the device intelligence / Fabric Gateway service.'
degradation_path.significance: Proves the honest, non-fabricating degradation design (P6.5) holds against a real killed process, not just a simulated fetch rejection in a test double

live_cross_service_proof.additional_check: GET /api/v1/health on backend confirmed status=ok with no database connection (NODE_ENV=development does not require DATABASE_URL)
